name: GASP
definition: A pipeline that integrates Gaussian Splatting with physics-based simulations by converting flat Gaussians into triangle faces using GaMeS, simulating the vertices using a standard MPM engine, and reassembling the deformed triangles back into Gaussians.
summary: GASP is a pipeline that simulates deformable objects in Gaussian Splatting by converting flat Gaussians into triangle faces for physics simulation, then reconstructing Gaussians to avoid artifacts and engine modifications.
